extraction_notes: Titled 'תוצאות סקר 6.8'. PDF does not name the pollster or commissioner; taken from CEC metadata (טאטיקה מחקרים ומדיה for זמן ישראל). Fieldwork 5/8 10:00 to 6/8 13:00 (year 2026). Method: internet panel + phone completions ('פאנל אינטרנטי + השלמות טלפוניות למידה ויש חוסר במדגם'). Initial sample: 11,000 SMS with link + 52 phone calls = 11,052; 556 answered, 56 (5.03%) excluded as unfit/out of quota -> 500 respondents; 95% did not participate -> response rate recorded as 5.0. Margin of error 4.4%. Page 3-4 contain a non-vote question about Segalovitz joining Ra'am - ignored.
